description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and query-building logic for data visualization and analysis, including handling of metrics, columns, filters, and post-processing operators in a data visualization context.

classes.name: RollingType
classes.description: Enumeration for different types of rolling window calculations.

classes.name: ComparisonType
classes.description: Enumeration for different comparison types used in data analysis.

classes.name: DatasourceType
classes.description: Enumeration for different types of data sources.

classes.name: DatasourceKey
classes.description: Class representing a data source key with id and type, providing serialization methods.

methods.name: ensure_is_array
methods.description: Ensures the input value is returned as a list, wrapping non-list values.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a value is None or an empty collection.

methods.name: is_saved_metric
methods.description: Checks if a metric is a saved metric (string).

methods.name: is_adhoc_metric_simple
methods.description: Checks if a metric dict is a simple adhoc metric.

methods.name: is_adhoc_metric_sql
methods.description: Checks if a metric dict is an SQL adhoc metric.

methods.name: is_query_form_metric
methods.description: Checks if a metric is of any query form type.

methods.name: get_metric_label
methods.description: Retrieves the label for a given metric object.

methods.name: extract_extra_metrics
methods.description: Extracts extra metrics from form data based on specific conditions.

methods.name: get_metric_offsets_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping of metric offset labels to metric labels based on form data and query object.

methods.name: is_time_comparison
methods.description: Determines if the query involves a time comparison based on form data and query object.

methods.name: ensure_is_int
methods.description: Converts a value to int, returning default or NaN on failure.

methods.name: is_physical_column
methods.description: Checks if a column is a physical column (string).

methods.name: is_adhoc_column
methods.description: Checks if a column is an adhoc column with SQL expression.

methods.name: is_query_form_column
methods.description: Checks if a column is either physical or adhoc.

methods.name: is_x_axis_set
methods.description: Checks if x_axis is specified in form data.

methods.name: get_x_axis_column
methods.description: Retrieves the x_axis column from form data.

methods.name: get_column_label
methods.description: Returns the label for a column.

methods.name: get_x_axis_label
methods.description: Returns the x_axis label from form data.

methods.name: time_compare_pivot_operator
methods.description: Creates pivot operation configuration for time comparison.

methods.name: pivot_operator
methods.description: Creates pivot operation configuration for post-processing.

methods.name: normalize_order_by
methods.description: Normalizes the orderby clause in a query object.

methods.name: remove_duplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate items from a list, optionally using a hash function.

methods.name: extract_fields_from_form_data
methods.description: Extracts columns, metrics, and orderby from form data.

methods.name: extract_query_fields
methods.description: Extracts query fields from form data, applying aliases.

methods.name: extract_extras
methods.description: Extracts extra parameters and filters from form data.

methods.name: is_defined
methods.description: Checks if a value is not None.

methods.name: sanitize_clause
methods.description: Sanitizes a SQL clause, appending newline if '--' present, and wrapping in parentheses.

methods.name: is_unary_operator
methods.description: Checks if an operator is unary.

methods.name: is_binary_operator
methods.description: Checks if an operator is binary.

methods.name: is_set_operator
methods.description: Checks if an operator is a set operator.

methods.name: is_unary_adhoc_filter
methods.description: Checks if a filter's operator is unary.

methods.name: is_binary_adhoc_filter
methods.description: Checks if a filter's operator is binary.

methods.name: convert_filter
methods.description: Converts an adhoc filter into a query clause dictionary.

methods.name: is_simple_adhoc_filter
methods.description: Checks if a filter is a simple adhoc filter.

methods.name: process_filters
methods.description: Processes filters from form data, splitting into simple and freeform clauses.

methods.name: override_extra_form_data
methods.description: Overrides parts of a query object with values from override form data.

methods.name: build_query_object
methods.description: Builds a query object from form data, including filters, metrics, columns, and other parameters.

methods.name: omit
methods.description: Returns a copy of a dictionary without specified keys.

methods.name: normalize_time_column
methods.description: Updates the time column in query object based on form data.

methods.name: build_query_context
methods.description: Builds the full query context including datasource, queries, and form data.

methods.name: rolling_window_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for rolling window calculations.

methods.name: time_compare_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for time comparison.

methods.name: resample_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for resampling.

methods.name: rename_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration to rename columns.

methods.name: contribution_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for contribution analysis.

methods.name: sort_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for sorting.

methods.name: flatten_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for flatten operation.

methods.name: prophet_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for Prophet forecasting.

methods.name: rank_operator
methods.description: Creates post-processing configuration for ranking.

methods.name: drop_none_values
methods.description: Removes keys with None values from a dictionary.

methods.name: histogram_operator
methods.description: Creates histogram operator configuration based on form data.

methods.name: retain_form_data_suffix
methods.description: Retains keys ending with a suffix, removing the suffix from keys.

methods.name: remove_form_data_suffix
methods.description: Removes keys ending with a suffix from form data.
